title: EverestIMS Technologies IPO Details
intro:
EverestIMS Technologies IPO is a book build issue of ₹48.46 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 45.94 lakh shares aggregating to ₹39.05 crores and offer for sale of 11.07 lakh shares aggregating to ₹9.41 crores.

EverestIMS Technologies IPO opens for subscription on Sep 29, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the EverestIMS Technologies IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. EverestIMS Technologies IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

EverestIMS Technologies IPO is set issue price band at ₹80 to ₹85 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,72,000 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,08,000.

Oneview Corporate Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is KG Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to EverestIMS Technologies IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in April 2017, EverestIMS Technologies Limited is a software enterprise that offers both Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions and on-premise products and services. The company specializes in digital transformation, IT operations, and AI-driven product solutions to streamline IT processes, improve efficiency, and enhance user experiences. The company offers solutions for remote monitoring of critical network devices, servers, and applications, reducing downtime and improving IT operations with its platform ' Infraon Infinity '.

The company engage in direct sales through both the Company and their subsidiary, Infraon Corp, located in the USA. In addition, they engage with domestic & international channel partners, distributors and sales agents who identify potential customers, work jointly with them to qualify and close deals.
The company generates revenue mainly from: (i) software product sales and (ii) service sales.
As of March 31, 2026, the company employed 230 people.

faqs.question: How to apply in EverestIMS Technologies IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in EverestIMS Technologies IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in EverestIMS Technologies IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in EverestIMS Technologies IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' EverestIMS Technologies IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for EverestIMS Technologies IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in EverestIMS Technologies IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for EverestIMS Technologies IPO will be done on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Oct 7, 2026 . Check the EverestIMS Technologies IPO allotment status .
